```{r}
library(readr)

# Load HousingPanelwide data
HousingPanelwide <- read_csv("d:/PositStuff/gmpanel/HousingPanelwide.csv")

ts.plot(cbind(log(HousingPanelwide$`kersal.Local Authority etc`),log(HousingPanelwide$`quays.Local Authority etc`)),col=c("darkgreen","red"),xlab="Census Wave",ylab="log(HousingTenure)",main="Local authority owned tenure 1971-2021 census")
  legend("bottomleft",legend = c("kersal_log(green)","quays_log(red)"),col=c("darkgreen","red"),bty = "n")

ts.plot(cbind(log(HousingPanelwide$`chettam.Local Authority etc`),log(HousingPanelwide$`ancoats.Local Authority etc`),log(HousingPanelwide$`crumpsall.Local Authority etc`)),col=c("darkgreen","red","darkblue"),xlab="Census Wave",ylab="log(HousingTenure)",main="Local authority owned tenure 1971-2021 census")
legend("bottomleft",legend = c("chettam_log(green)","ancoats_log(red)","crumpsall_log(blue)"),col=c("darkgreen","red","darkblue"),bty = "n")
```

```{r}
EducationPanelwide <- read_csv("d:/PositStuff/gmpanel/EducationPanelwide.csv")

ts.plot(cbind(EducationPanelwide$`kersal.Graduate`/(EducationPanelwide$kersal.Graduate+EducationPanelwide$`kersal.Not graduate`),EducationPanelwide$`quays.Graduate`/(EducationPanelwide$quays.Graduate+EducationPanelwide$`quays.Not graduate`)),col=c("darkgreen","red"),xlab="Census Wave",ylab="%Graduates",main="Graduate education 1971-2021 census")
  legend("topleft",legend = c("kersal(green)","quays(red)"),col=c("darkgreen","red"),bty = "n")

ts.plot(cbind(EducationPanelwide$`chettam.Graduate`/(EducationPanelwide$chettam.Graduate+EducationPanelwide$`chettam.Not graduate`),EducationPanelwide$`ancoats.Graduate`/(EducationPanelwide$ancoats.Graduate+EducationPanelwide$`ancoats.Not graduate`),EducationPanelwide$`crumpsall.Graduate`/(EducationPanelwide$crumpsall.Graduate+EducationPanelwide$`crumpsall.Not graduate`)),col=c("darkgreen","red","darkblue"),xlab="Census Wave",ylab="%Graduates",main="Graduate education 1971-2021 census")
legend("topleft",legend = c("chettam(green)","ancoats(red)","crumpsall(blue)"),col=c("darkgreen","red","darkblue"),bty = "n")
```
